dedupe_keys.name: modelon data center library modelica models of data centre cooling chains with calibrated coolant distribution units

description: The Data Center Library is a commercial Modelica-based library from Modelon for modelling the complete cooling chain of data centres and testing designs and control strategies under realistic operating conditions. Contents: components and reference architectures for chiller plants, chillers with waterside economisers, multi-chiller configurations and hybrid rack arrangements, including a ready-to-use liquid-cooled AI cluster model, and pre-calibrated models of coolant distribution units (CDUs) from leading manufacturers across the ASHRAE W1 to W4 water temperature classes; Modelon reports under 1.4% error on a 2 MW reference CDU. Users can compare vendor CDUs at a facility's water temperatures, evaluate control strategies, setpoints and free-cooling use, and size equipment before procurement. Producer: Modelon. Coverage: hyperscale, colocation and enterprise facilities. Format and access: Modelica library in Modelon Impact; demonstrations on request. Licence: commercial Modelon licence. Caveats: accuracy figures are the vendor's own; needs a paid licence. Simulation uses: cooling capacity and resilience analysis of data centres, energy efficiency studies and design of cooling for AI clusters. Related records: case_study-deepmind-google-data-centre-cooling-control, model-alphadatacentercooling and model-sustaindc.
